newFindings.title: spec 267 regression: the exec path command-shape clause is 260 characters, over the kernel's 256-character ToolInputIssue bound, so the issue is dropped and the model sees a bare invalid-input
newFindings.inSituEvidence: httpx-multipart-response-parsing, this batch: two exec calls are refused as {kind:'not-invoked', reason:'invalid-input'} with NO issue at all - input {command:'ls -la /app'} and input {command:'cd /app && git log --oneline -3 && git status'}. In the before-image the same class of command-shape refusal carried the 143-character clause message ({code:'invalid', field:'command', message:'must be one command name without "/" or "\\" (resolved from the captured PATH, spaces and Unicode allowed) or a bounded absolute executable path'}, 4 occurrences).
newFindings.rootCause: EXEC_COMMAND_SHAPE.path is both the description sentence and the rejection message (capability-builtin-tools): 143 -> 260 characters, while copyToolInputIssue enforces MAX_TOOL_INPUT_SYNTAX_MESSAGE_CHARACTERS = 256 (v3/src/kernel/data.ts:149, :210) and returns undefined, so transition.ts:777-783 falls back to 'invalid-input' and silently drops the issue.
newFindings.localEvidence: A local probe through the built CLI reproduced it deterministically (command 'node_modules/.bin/jest'); the built model-visible transcript for that call records only {kind:'not-invoked', reason:'invalid-input'}.
newFindings.recommendedCheck: Assert at composition level that every model-visible ToolInputIssue message fits the kernel bound, so a wording change can never again degrade silently into 'invalid-input'.

newFindings.observation: residual wording: process-start's model-visible description still contains 'argv[0] is one command name without a path separator (spaces and Unicode allowed) resolved from the captured startup PATH ...' (packages/capability-process-tools/src/index.ts:265). Unlike the exec clause this sentence already states 'one command name' and 'no shell expansion', so it is recorded as a wording follow-up in issue #186 rather than a defect.
newFindings.status: not fixed in this batch; no effect observed in any cell
